answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a wharf charging a berth fee: one stake opens one bridge into the marketplace, not a thousand free copies. If an agent cheats or clones itself, its stake is slashed, so growing a grove of fake identities means forfeiting a grove of deposits. Honest agents recover their stake over time, while a Sybil farmer must pay full price for every clone, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
